name: Valiant II
description:
The S-series Chrysler Valiant was produced in Argentina by FEVRE (Fabricaciones Especiales Villa del Rosario) as the Argentinian version of the Valiant family. This example features the legendary Slant Six RG225 (225 cubic inch / 3.7L) inline-six engine with a single carburetor, producing 137 bhp at 4000 rpm and 284 Nm (29 kgm) of torque at 2400 rpm. The RG225 provides excellent low-end grunt and reliability characteristic of these robust powerplants.

v1.3 - Street specification with period-correct 185/70 R14 tyres and authentic 1960s suspension tuning.
author: BJ911
